args.title: Support currency symbols ₹ and CHF in ParseAmount
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

The parseAmount function should be updated to include the rupee (₹) and Swiss franc symbols for stripping. This will ensure that amounts like ₹1,250.00 and -₹310.50 are properly parsed and not rejected as 'not a number'.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parseAmount function does not handle the ₹ symbol in amounts, causing imports to fail. Adding this symbol to the stripping process will resolve the issue.
